column1: # A VARIABLE USED AS A PATH SEGMENT RENDERS ITS EXACT DIGITS.
# `$big` is integer 2^60. Under `'' + peg` a JS number gives the shortest
# round-tripping form (1152921504606847000) -- a DIFFERENT integer -- so
# TypeScript addressed a key that does not exist and missed the one that
# does. Go dispatched on kind here and was already right.
# The PAIR is the assertion. The first row alone passes in a broken port if
# the document happens to contain the rounded key; the second says the
# rounded key must NOT be reachable. Together they pin the exact rendering.
